page.overview:
Who is Leonero?

Leonero is a member of the Spade Pirates.

Leonero is a tall man with a large rounded jaw, pointy ears, and long legs. He wears a pinstripe jumpsuit, light-colored shoes, a top hat, and sunglasses. In Wano Country, he wore a dark-colored suit.

Leonero cares greatly about his captain, Portgas D. Ace, since he was willing to defend him from Edward Newgate. Leonero can also be somewhat disrespectful, laughing at Deuce's adventure diary despite the fact that it is his main aspiration of their travels.

Like the rest of the Spade Pirates, Leonero cares greatly for his captain, defending him from an Emperor. However, he was not seen at the Summit War of Marineford.
